title: Plach
concept: A series of voyeuristic observations of a pursuit through decaying urban and industrial landscapes.
style: A recurring figure appears throughout: A young man in an oversized black leather trench coat and heavy combat boots..

scenes.still_prompt: A dark, subterranean concrete bunker filled with shallow pools of black oil reflecting flickering overhead lights.
beats: Extreme close-up: the figure's boots stepping into a black liquid surface.
Medium shot: the figure standing motionless in the center of the dark room.
Low angle shot: the figure tilting their head back toward the ceiling.
Close-up: the figure's hand dipping into the oily pool.
Wide shot: the figure walking slowly toward a heavy iron door.
scenes.video_prompt: Thick oily ripples spreading across the dark floor. The material texture of the image stays constant and visible throughout.

motion.low: A slow, creeping dolly shot following the figure's feet.

scenes.still_prompt: A narrow, derelict factory corridor lined with soot-stained brick walls and rusted metal pipes.
beats: Wide shot: the figure walking down the center of the long hallway.
Medium shot: the figure turning a corner sharply.
Close-up: the figure's hand brushing against a rough brick wall.
Low angle shot: the figure looking over their shoulder into the darkness.
Medium shot: the figure stopping abruptly to catch their breath.
scenes.video_prompt: Fine grey dust falling from the ceiling beams. The material texture of the image stays constant and visible throughout.

motion.mid: A steady handheld follow shot at walking pace.

beats: Overhead shot: the figure sitting perfectly still in a chair.
Close-up: the figure's hands gripped tightly on the metal table.
Medium shot: the figure staring at an empty chair opposite them.
Extreme close-up: the figure's eyes blinking slowly.
Wide shot: the figure slumped forward in the chair.
scenes.video_prompt: A single overhead lightbulb vibrating slightly in its socket. The material texture of the image stays constant and visible throughout.

motion.low: A very slow zoom into the figure's face.

beats: Wide shot: the figure running through the narrow passage.
Medium shot: the figure stumbling against a wall of flickering neon tubes.

Low angle shot: the figure jumping over a large puddle.
Medium shot: the figure spinning around to face the camera.
Wide shot: the figure disappearing into a cloud of steam.

motion.high: A frantic, shaky handheld camera tracking the figure's movement.
